questions.question: In which year was IIT Roorkee formally designated as an IIT?
questions.ground_truth: IIT Roorkee was formally designated as an IIT on September 21, 2001, through a Government of India ordinance.

questions.question: How many full-time postgraduate programmes does IIT Roorkee offer according to the PG brochure?
questions.ground_truth: IIT Roorkee offers 57 full-time postgraduate programmes in various disciplines.

questions.question: What is the full form of FTRS in PhD admission categories?
questions.ground_truth: FTRS stands for Full-Time Research Scholar.

questions.question: What does PTRS stand for in IIT Roorkee PhD admissions?
questions.ground_truth: PTRS stands for Part-Time Research Scholar.

questions.question: Which document is required for sponsored candidates to prove work experience?
questions.ground_truth: Sponsored candidates must provide experience certificate and sponsorship certificate from employer.

questions.question: What is the minimum educational qualification for M.Tech admission in terms of degree duration?
questions.ground_truth: Candidates must hold a four-year bachelor's degree or equivalent for M.Tech admission.

questions.question: What is the name of the institute located in Roorkee that was established 178 years ago?
questions.ground_truth: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee, with a legacy spanning 178 years, is among the oldest engineering institutions in India.

questions.question: What is the Golden Girl scheme in PhD admissions?
questions.ground_truth: Golden Girl scheme is a special PhD admission category to encourage female candidates, offering additional opportunities.

questions.question: Which departments offer Materials Chemistry specialization in PhD?
questions.ground_truth: Chemistry department offers Materials Chemistry as a PhD specialization along with Analytical, Inorganic, Organic, and Physical Chemistry.

questions.question: What is the duration of part-time sponsored M.Tech programme?
questions.ground_truth: Part-Time Sponsored M.Tech programme has a duration of three years.

questions.question: Can M.Tech students switch to PhD programme after first year at IIT Roorkee?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, M.Tech/M.Arch/MURP candidates pursuing PG degree can switch to PhD programme after 1st year subject to eligibility criteria.

questions.question: What is the location of IIT Roorkee main campus?
questions.ground_truth: IIT Roorkee main campus is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, India.

questions.question: What is MURP in the context of IIT Roorkee PG programmes?
questions.ground_truth: MURP stands for Master of Urban and Rural Planning, offered as a postgraduate programme at IIT Roorkee.
required_facts: Master of Urban and Rural Planning

questions.question: What is the full form of AMIE mentioned in M.Tech eligibility?
questions.ground_truth: AMIE stands for Associate Member of the Institution of Engineers.
required_facts: Associate Member of the Institution of Engineers

questions.question: What type of institution is IIT Roorkee classified as?
questions.ground_truth: IIT Roorkee is classified as an Institution of National Importance and an Indian Institute of Technology.

questions.question: How to apply for PG programmes at IIT Roorkee?
questions.ground_truth: Candidates must apply online through the official IIT Roorkee admission portal, fill the application form, upload required documents, and pay application fee.

questions.question: What are the steps for PhD application submission?
questions.ground_truth: PhD application involves online registration, filling academic details, uploading certificates, research proposal, and payment of fee before deadline.

questions.question: What documents are required to be uploaded for M.Tech application?
questions.ground_truth: Required documents include qualifying degree certificate, mark sheets, category certificate if applicable, GATE score card, photograph, signature, and sponsorship certificate for sponsored category.

questions.question: How is selection for PhD done at IIT Roorkee?
questions.ground_truth: PhD selection is based on academic performance, GATE/NET qualification, written test and/or interview conducted by department.

questions.question: What is the procedure for sponsored candidates to get admission?
questions.ground_truth: Sponsored candidates need minimum two years full-time work experience, sponsorship letter from employer, and must meet minimum educational qualifications.

questions.question: How to check important dates for PG admission 2026?
questions.ground_truth: Important dates for PG admission 2026 are listed in the information brochure and on the official IIT Roorkee website under admissions section.

questions.question: What is the process for international candidates to apply for M.Tech?
questions.ground_truth: International candidates holding bachelor's degree in relevant field must apply through international admission portal and meet minimum qualifications.

questions.question: How to apply for dual degree programme switching from M.Tech to PhD?
questions.ground_truth: M.Tech students can apply for switching to PhD after first year by submitting application through department and satisfying eligibility criteria.

questions.question: What is the procedure for part-time PhD research scholars?
questions.ground_truth: Part-time research scholars must be employed, have employer NOC, minimum experience, and attend coursework as per department requirements.

questions.question: How to pay application fee for PG admission?
questions.ground_truth: Application fee must be paid online through net banking, credit/debit card or UPI during online application submission. Fee is non-refundable.

questions.question: What is the minimum percentage required for General category candidates for M.Tech admission?
questions.ground_truth: General, Gen-EWS and OBC category candidates must have at least 60% marks or CGPA 6.00 on 10 point scale at qualifying degree.

questions.question: What is the minimum percentage for SC/ST/PWD candidates for M.Tech?
questions.ground_truth: SC/ST/PWD category candidates need at least 55% marks or 5.50 CGPA on 10 point scale at qualifying degree level.

questions.question: What is the minimum educational qualification for PhD in Chemistry?
questions.ground_truth: For PhD in Chemistry, candidates need M.Sc. or equivalent degree in Chemistry/Physics/Applied Chemistry with minimum marks.

questions.question: What work experience is required for full-time sponsored M.Tech candidates?
questions.ground_truth: Full-time sponsored candidates must have minimum two years full-time work experience in responsible capacity in relevant field.

questions.question: Are candidates with AMIE eligible for M.Tech at IIT Roorkee?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, candidates with AMIE/AMIS/AMIIChE/AMIIM/Grad IETE plus B.Sc. or Diploma and three years research/teaching/professional experience are eligible.

questions.question: What is the eligibility for international candidates for M.Tech?
questions.ground_truth: International candidates holding bachelor's degree or equivalent in Engineering/Technology/Architecture/Planning/Design and meeting minimum qualifications are eligible.

questions.question: What is common minimum eligibility criteria for PhD admission?
questions.ground_truth: Common minimum eligibility includes master's degree in relevant discipline with minimum marks and valid GATE/NET or equivalent qualification.

questions.question: What is the minimum CGPA required for General category for PhD?
questions.ground_truth: General category candidates need 60% or 6.0 CGPA for PhD admission, while SC/ST/PWD need 55% or 5.5 CGPA.

questions.question: Is GATE required for sponsored M.Tech candidates?
questions.ground_truth: Sponsored candidates may be exempted from GATE requirement but must have work experience and sponsorship, department may conduct interview.

questions.question: What is the age limit for PhD admission at IIT Roorkee?
questions.ground_truth: There is generally no strict age limit for PhD admission, but candidates must meet educational qualifications and department-specific criteria.

questions.question: If a candidate has 58% in qualifying degree and belongs to General category, is he eligible for M.Tech?
questions.ground_truth: No, General category requires 60% minimum, so 58% is not eligible for M.Tech.

questions.question: If an M.Tech student wants to switch to PhD after first year, what conditions must be satisfied?
questions.ground_truth: Must have completed first year of M.Tech, satisfy PhD eligibility criteria as per applicable rules, and get department approval.

questions.question: If a sponsored candidate has only 1 year experience, can he apply for full-time sponsored M.Tech?
questions.ground_truth: No, full-time sponsored candidates must have minimum two years full-time work experience till last date of application.

questions.question: If a candidate belongs to SC category with 56% marks, is he eligible for M.Tech?
questions.ground_truth: Yes, SC category requires 55% minimum, so 56% makes him eligible.

questions.question: If a candidate has AMIE but no B.Sc. or Diploma, is he eligible for M.Tech?
questions.ground_truth: No, AMIE candidates must also possess B.Sc. or Diploma in engineering and three years experience to be eligible.

questions.question: What is the total number of pages in PG Information Brochure 2026?
questions.ground_truth: PG Information Brochure 2026 has 25 pages.

questions.question: What is the minimum CGPA on 10-point scale for General category for M.Tech?
questions.ground_truth: Minimum CGPA is 6.00 on 10-point scale for General, Gen-EWS and OBC category.

questions.question: How many years of work experience are required for full-time sponsored candidates?
questions.ground_truth: Minimum two years of full-time work experience is required for full-time sponsored candidates.

questions.question: What is the duration of part-time sponsored M.Tech programme in years?
questions.ground_truth: Part-time sponsored M.Tech programme duration is three years.

questions.question: How many years of professional experience are required for AMIE candidates to be eligible for M.Tech?
questions.ground_truth: AMIE candidates need at least three years research, teaching or professional experience in relevant field.

questions.question: What are the admission categories for Indian candidates for M.Tech and what is the eligibility for each?
questions.ground_truth: Categories include Regular with GATE, Sponsored full-time requiring 2 years experience, Part-time sponsored 3-year duration, and eligibility is 60% for General/OBC/EWS and 55% for SC/ST/PWD with four-year bachelor's degree.

questions.question: Explain PhD admission categories FTRS and PTRS including their requirements and differences.
questions.ground_truth: FTRS is Full-Time Research Scholar who pursues PhD full-time with fellowship, PTRS is Part-Time Research Scholar who is employed, needs NOC, works part-time on PhD while employed.

questions.question: What are the documents required for PG application and how should they be uploaded?
questions.ground_truth: Documents include degree certificate, marksheets, GATE card, category certificate, photo, signature, sponsorship certificate. They must be uploaded online in specified format during application.

questions.question: What are the minimum educational qualifications for PhD in Chemistry and what specializations are offered?
questions.ground_truth: MEQ is M.Sc. or equivalent in Chemistry/Physics/Applied Chemistry. Specializations include Materials Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Inorganic, Organic, Physical Chemistry.

questions.question: What is the application fee payment process and what are the important dates for PG admission 2026?
questions.ground_truth: Application fee is non-refundable, paid online via net banking/card/UPI. Important dates are listed in brochure and official website for application start, end, and selection.
